notes: Zones come from Pace's own On_Demand layer (11 features, matching the 11 zones on pacebus.com/ondemand, including the renamed Northwest Cook and Lansing Area). Layer names are mapped to rider-facing names (e.g. 'Lansing On Demand' to Lansing Area). Do not use the older CMAP copy (Apr 2024), which is stale. Pace GTFS has no Flex. Pickup method is not given in the source notes, so it is left out. Children under 7 ride free (max two per fare-paying adult); no minimum age is stated.
